notes: The custom module composition's authored surface. Its module list is derived from the current module set (every module offered as 'optional'), so the modules are not authored here — only the identity the composition publishes under and the per-slot composition actions it applies.

Every action carries 'optionalTarget': true because the custom composition's modules are chosen per card: a selection that omits the target's module is an ordinary card, not an authoring error, so an unmatched action is silently inapplicable rather than a warning. An action matching more than one requirement blocks (recipe_composition_action_ambiguous).

Actions target imported slot ids — the stable requirement identity that survives module versioning — and are validated at load: every target must resolve to exactly one requirement across the offered module set, or the server refuses to start.

The recipeVersionId versions forward exactly like an authored composition. Superseded versions are retained verbatim by generated/composition-ledger.json; do not edit a version a published release pins — author the next one.
The runtime drops 'reason' (authoring rationale, not runtime data), matching how build-recipe-compositions.ts treats seed/procedure-compositions.json.
